# Slam Dunk Bets

> Slam Dunk Bets (Slam Dunk Betting Services LLC, founded 2020) is a subscription sports betting picks and data service run by data scientists and engineers. We build machine learning models that project NBA and WNBA first-basket and other first-event props (about 15 markets) and MLB home runs and NRFI/YRFI (no/yes runs in the first inning). Projections and sportsbook odds refresh every 30 minutes, plays post automatically to a Discord server with recommended unit sizes, and every recommended bet is tracked and graded publicly: 8,000+ net units since the 2021-22 NBA season.

Key facts:
- Markets: NBA and WNBA first basket (points and field goals), first basket exact method, first basket by team, team to score first, win tipoff, first assist/rebound/block/steal, and more; MLB home runs by batter and NRFI/YRFI.
- Method: ensembles of machine learning models on play-by-play, Statcast, lineup and odds data; a play is flagged when a sportsbook price is at least 1.5 percentage points better than our projected probability (2 points for MLB home runs); unit sizes are Kelly-based (half-Kelly for MLB), normalized so the average play is about 1 unit.
- Odds compared across 13 sportsbooks and prediction exchanges (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, Caesars, bet365, Fanatics, BetRivers, Hard Rock, Circa, theScore, Kalshi, Novig, ProphetX).
- Delivery: Discord server (picks, alerts, daily ROI receipts) plus the Slam Dunk Dashboard web app at https://app.slamdunk.bet (sign in with Discord or Google).
- Pricing (same on Sharpduel and Whop): $19.99/week, $49.99/month, $499.99/year, each with a 30-day free trial.
- Subscribe: https://sharpduel.com/slam_dunk_bets (preferred) or https://whop.com/slam-dunk-bets
- Contact: slamdunkbettingservices@gmail.com; X: https://x.com/slam_dunk_bets (brand) and https://x.com/jimtheflash (founder)
- 21+ only. Slam Dunk Bets is an information service and does not accept wagers. Problem gambling help: 1-800-GAMBLER.
